title: Live prompt-cache regression baseline is executable and fail-closed
acceptance: The missing live-cache test support modules are restored from the upstream source whose runner blob matches this repository.
live-cache-regression-runner.ts is back in the openclaw_runtime core typecheck and the image probe uses a tracked runtime PNG.

Anthropic floor misses are hard regressions; OpenAI warn-only lanes produce warnings only.
